frozen_mutation_rule.input_original: the exact R48O two-swap mutated_original returned by r48o.reconstruct_root()
frozen_mutation_rule.target_support_rule: reconstruct the sealed baseline prefix, run pivot 10, run exact frozen R47J, require exactly one surviving width-5 clause, then set TARGET_VARS = abs(literals of that clause) union {10}
frozen_mutation_rule.source_clause_rule: all clauses of the exact 3-CNF input_original whose variable support intersects TARGET_VARS, in canonical order
frozen_mutation_rule.replacement_rule: reuse r47i.signed_same_support_variants(source) and r47i.mutate_one_clause without modification
frozen_mutation_rule.validity: every mutant must remain exact 3-CNF and pass r47x.validate_exact_3cnf

reachability_rule.prefix_step_requirement: candidate exists, full independent replay passes, step is nonterminal, and persisted final width <= 4

pivot10_test.strong_W4_obstruction_followup: only after a dangerous pivot10 candidate is found, scan every current variable with frozen R48O/R47M semantics and independent replay; a strong existential W4 obstruction requires no eligible terminal and no eligible nonterminal successor with final width <= 4
